shipped_rows.title_o: The Big Picture: Effects of Surround on Immersion and Size Perception

blind_target.evidence_quote: Moran et al. (2017, VSS) found that realistic miniature increased immersion relative to unrealistic miniatures, but memory was unaffected. However, the questions used to assess memory were very easy, raising the possibility of a ceiling effect. The current experiment was very similar to Moran et al. (2017).
blind_target.outcome_quote: However, immersion results failed to replicate: immersion scores did not significantly differ across the three conditions.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The title focuses on immersion and this effect explicitly failed. The prior memory null was also recovered; under the title-specific coding rule the central immersion finding is failed. The directly repeated study is Moran et al. (2017), not the earlier Baranowski and Hecht paper. No reference list is available to expand the citation.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract states that the current experiment closely followed Moran et al. (2017, VSS), repeated its immersion comparison, and that the immersion result did not replicate. However, the supplied context is only a conference abstract and provides no full reference identity (title/authors/DOI) or primary report against which to resolve whether this is a distinct work or an alternate report. The supplied Baranowski and Hecht row is described as earlier background and its questionnaire was used, but that does not establish it as Moran's same original. Need the Moran VSS abstract/reference or full report and evidence resolving report identity.
luna_triage.omission_quote: The current experiment was very similar to Moran et al. (2017).
luna_triage.identity_quote: Moran et al. (2017, VSS) found that realistic miniature increased immersion relative to unrealistic miniatures, but memory was unaffected.
luna_triage.duplicate_quote: Previous research suggests that viewing movies in realistic miniature theaters can increase feelings of immersion relative to viewing movies on isolated monitors (Baranowski & Hecht, 2014, Perception).

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
